stories.title: Republican forces impeachment vote on Hegseth
stories.summary: Rep. Thomas Massie filed a resolution to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, forcing a House vote that is expected to fail but that pressures Trump to move first. The challenge lands days after Republican midterm losses and White House denials that Hegseth or Marco Rubio are leaving.

stories.title: Turkey steel plant blast kills at least 16
stories.summary: An explosion at the Habas Demir Celik steel plant in Aliaga, near Izmir, killed at least 16 people. Witnesses said the blast shook the ground and was initially mistaken for an earthquake.

stories.title: Trump questions midterm election integrity
stories.summary: Trump claimed on Truth Social, without evidence, that the midterm elections were compromised, reversing his earlier acceptance of the results. The posts come as Republicans absorb losses and a new Democratic Congress prepares to take control.

stories.title: At least 34 die as migrant boat sinks off Senegal
stories.summary: A boat carrying migrants toward the Canary Islands sank off Senegal, killing at least 34 people in one of the deadliest recent crossings on the Atlantic route. The disaster underscores the pull of the route in a country where nearly one in four young people is unemployed.

stories.title: Nvidia shares tumble over Huang spy investigation
stories.summary: Nvidia shares fell sharply Monday, wiping hundreds of billions of dollars in market value, as a national security investigation into CEO Jensen Huang and a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy raised questions about the chipmaker and its China business. Huang has acknowledged the affair as the company runs its own inquiry.

stories.title: Linux SSH flaw exploited in the wild
stories.summary: A vulnerability that lets attackers gain SSH access to Linux devices is under active exploitation, with researchers describing mature intrusions rather than opportunistic scans. Exposed hosts should be patched or blocked at the network edge.

stories.title: Anthropic ships Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
stories.summary: Anthropic released upgraded Fable and Mythos 5.2 models, claiming outputs up to 30% faster and lower pricing at 8 dollars per million input tokens, with gains in coding, reasoning, science and cybersecurity. The company says it added new sandbox-escape evaluations and its strongest protections yet against distillation attacks.

stories.title: France blames Iran for hacks on freezers, blood banks
stories.summary: Paris accused Iran of orchestrating cyberattacks that drove up temperatures in supermarket freezers and blood bank equipment, spoiling tons of chilled and frozen food in hundreds of stores. The campaign marks an escalation in Tehran operations against European civilian infrastructure.

stories.title: Browns to start Deshaun Watson at quarterback in Week 10
stories.summary: Cleveland plans to return to Deshaun Watson against Houston, ESPN reported, even after Shedeur Sanders delivered a productive performance in the overtime loss at New Orleans. Watson cleared concussion protocol but had not taken team reps in the week before Week 9.

stories.title: Monken not ready to name starter for Texans game
stories.summary: Browns coach Todd Monken said Monday he is not ready to pick between Deshaun Watson and Shedeur Sanders for Week 10, hours before reports pointed to Watson starting. Cleveland sits at 5-4 after the overtime loss in New Orleans.

stories.title: Browns weigh deadline move for pass rush
stories.summary: A day before the Tuesday 4 p.m. ET trade deadline, Cleveland is weighing whether to add an edge rusher after Jared Verse went nine games without a sack. Jets rusher Will McDonald IV asking out gives the Browns a possible target as they decide between buying and standing pat at 5-4.

stories.title: Ohio State parts with special teams coordinator Discher
stories.summary: Ohio State is firing special teams coordinator Discher after repeated special teams breakdowns, including the fake punt that helped Oregon rip off 38 straight points in a 41-28 win at Ohio Stadium. The Buckeyes are 6-3 and have lost two straight by double digits.

stories.title: College Football Playoff expanding to 24 teams
stories.summary: The CFP will grow to 24 teams next season, with the four Power 4 champions, the top Group of 6 team and 19 at-large selections making the field. The jump follows two years of the 12-team format that Ohio State won in its first season.

stories.title: Apple TV to stream Las Vegas GP weekend free in US
stories.summary: Apple TV confirmed the full Las Vegas Grand Prix weekend, from first practice through the Saturday night race, will stream free in the United States with no subscription. Las Vegas opens the final triple-header, with both titles already settled by Kimi Antonelli and Mercedes.

stories.title: Piastri splits from Mark Webber management
stories.summary: Oscar Piastri has ended his management arrangement with Mark Webber, a break foreshadowed earlier this season when Webber was expected to move into a more behind-the-scenes role. The change comes as Piastri enters the next phase of his F1 career.

stories.title: Mercedes says 2014-2021 style run is impossible now
stories.summary: Mercedes says a repeat of the eight straight constructors titles it won from 2014 to 2021 is impossible under the current rules and cost controls. The team still swept both 2026 championships, with Kimi Antonelli taking the drivers crown.

stories.title: FIA president moves to scrap age limits for officials
stories.summary: FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem is planning to remove age limits for office-holders at the governing body, a change that would let him and other officials serve longer. The proposal adds to scrutiny of governance under his leadership.

stories.title: Players say six-hour Therapist quests distort the league
stories.summary: Tarkov players are reporting that Therapist quests with six-hour timers are reshaping how the new league system plays, with cooldowns dictating when raids are worth running. The thread has become one of the louder balance complaints of the season.

stories.title: Players tie weapon overswing to frame rate
stories.summary: A player-run analysis reports that weapon overswing scales with frame rate, with higher FPS producing more overswing, which would make the effect a frame-dependent input bug rather than a pure skill mechanic. The finding is drawing attention from players tuning sensitivity and graphics settings.

stories.title: ODOT worker killed by semi on I-70 in Zanesville
stories.summary: An Ohio Department of Transportation worker was struck and killed by a semi-truck on Interstate 70 in Zanesville on Monday, NBC4 reported. The death highlights the risk for road crews working along central Ohio interstates.

stories.title: Trial opens for Pammy Maye in death of 5-year-old
stories.summary: The trial of Pammy Maye, accused in the death of 5-year-old Darnell Taylor, began Monday in Columbus. The case drew national attention when an Amber Alert was issued for the boy in 2024.

stories.title: Honda to build 3 billion dollar hybrid plant in Ohio
stories.summary: Honda announced a 3 billion dollar assembly plant between its East Liberty and Marysville sites that is expected to create more than 2,000 jobs and build up to 240,000 vehicles a year. Production is targeted for 2029, pending approvals, and the line will handle hybrids, gas and battery-electric vehicles.

stories.title: Land-Grant buys Nocterra, will reopen Powell taproom
stories.summary: Columbus-based Land-Grant Brewing acquired Nocterra Brewing and plans to reopen the Powell taproom at 41 Depot St. in late November, reviving a brand that closed both locations on Aug. 31. Land-Grant says it will keep Nocterra beers and branding alive.
